g.text: E / I1 / I2 / I3: pergeseran terhadap neutral · logical_connective + self_reference + engagement 3

NA ≠ 0; marker hollow = low support (n_changed < 10); bentuk kondisi tetap. CI nominal 95%; target 99% belum terbukti.
